answer: Give every account a ledge of verifiable work: to climb, it must publish proofs tied to real public events, each signed and timestamped, so a Sybil farm faces labour it cannot fake cheaply. A mesa of reputation forms only when independent strangers from separate communities vouch for the same account without coordinating, and those vouches expire unless renewed by shared work. Keep a haven for newcomers: first-time accounts earn limited rights in a slow probationary queue where established members can flag abuse, so honest beginners enter while cloned identities wait behind real people.
